Services

TraceSeis, Inc provides comprehensive seismic integration services and specialized reservoir characterization software that precisely define the relationship between rock and reservoir properties. Our expert solutions reduce exploration risk by delivering quantitative reservoir property estimates using well-calibrated seismic data analysis.

Our Core Geoscience Services Include:

Seismic Data Processing

Our advanced seismic processing techniques enhance data quality and resolution, providing the foundation for reliable reservoir property estimation. We specialize in customized processing workflows that optimize your seismic data for interpretation and quantitative analysis.

Feasibility Studies

We conduct thorough feasibility assessments to determine the optimal approach for your specific exploration challenges. Our detailed studies evaluate data quality, geological complexity, and technical viability to ensure successful project outcomes.

Lithofacies Prediction

TraceSeis delivers accurate lithofacies prediction services using integrated seismic and well-log data. Our advanced rock physics modeling and machine learning techniques identify distinct geological units with high precision, enabling better reservoir characterization.

Inversion to Reservoir Properties

Our proprietary inversion methodologies transform seismic attributes into meaningful reservoir properties. Using innovative approaches that don’t require Low Frequency Models (LFMs), we provide reliable estimates of porosity, saturation, and other critical reservoir parameters.

Comprehensive Reservoir Analysis

Since 2003, our team has delivered trusted geoscience solutions to the oil and gas industry worldwide. Our SeisTool software and expert consulting services empower exploration and development geoscientists to make informed decisions in challenging environments.

Contact TraceSeis today to discover how our seismic integration expertise can strengthen your exploration workflow and reduce subsurface uncertainty.
